name: HT05b5. Referred to Prevention (Facility)
description: Number of tested HIV negative clients referred to HIV prevention services at health facility
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_self_testing a
JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
  ON mdp.client_id = a.client_id
WHERE
  a.encounter_date >= :startDate
  AND a.encounter_date <= :endDate
  AND mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
  AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
  AND a.distribution_model = 'ecb88326-0a3f-44a5-9bbf-df4bfc3239e1'
  AND a.confirmatory_test_results = 'dc85aa72-30ab-102d-86b0-7a5022ba4115'
  AND a.linked_to_hiv_prevention_services = '1065AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA'
;
